The note cautions that some estimates may be affected by higher non-response bias and that cross-country comparisons should be interpreted carefully because TALIS relies solely on self-reports. The document does not provide model-based performance metrics or ML-based prediction; instead, it points to specific OECD TALIS 2024 Database tables used to compute the reported percentages and significance tests. As a result, the findings are best interpreted as descriptive indicators of teacher/principal working conditions and reported practices rather than causal effects.
